one_line: Self-serve platform for selling digital products whose OAuth API manages products, sales, payouts, licenses, emails and subscriptions.
auth_notes: Register an OAuth application (app id + secret) then generate an access token; fine-grained scopes (view_sales, edit_products, view_payouts, etc.); legacy personal access token also used; Verify License API needs no token.
self_serve_notes: Free to join and fully self-serve; create an OAuth app on the Gumroad settings page and generate a token without payment. No app-store approval.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API covering products, variants, offer codes, custom fields, files/media, emails, workflows, sales, licenses, payouts, tax forms, earnings, resource subscriptions
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks (resource subscriptions) notify on sale/refund/dispute events to a configured URL; docs also ship a CLI wrapping every endpoint

existing_mcp.note: No official Gumroad MCP server found; community servers not verified

evidence.note: Fetched text (full gumroad.com/api docs) confirms OAuth2 app registration, scopes, access tokens, REST JSON API, webhooks, Verify License API

agent_notes: Docs are thin but the fetched page was substantive; OAuth + token generation is instant and free. Moderate breadth.
